Sandbox_VehicleLivingSlots_FridgePowerCo: Displayed at 1000 times the fridge's actual auxiliary-battery drain per game minute. Default: 0.04, giving about 17.36 game days on a full battery. Minimum: 0.01. A charged auxiliary battery is required.
Sandbox_VehicleLivingSlots_MicrowavePowe: Displayed at 1000 times the microwave's actual auxiliary-battery drain per active game minute. Default: 0.4, ten times the fridge rate. Minimum: 0.01. A charged auxiliary battery is required.
Sandbox_VehicleLivingSlots_TelevisionPow: Displayed at 1000 times the television's actual auxiliary-battery drain per active game minute. Default: 0.4, matching the microwave rate. Minimum: 0.01. A charged auxiliary battery is required.
Sandbox_VehicleLivingSlots_WaterPurifica: Displayed at 1000 times the auxiliary-battery drain per litre of water purified. Default: 0.4, matching the microwave rate. Minimum: 0.01. A charged auxiliary battery is required.

Racks are repairable; empty storage and remove cargo before disassembly into materials. Re-enabling does not create items.
Sandbox_VehicleLivingSlots_EnableRoofGen: Allows operating the roof generator beside a parked vehicle to power nearby buildings. Moving or disabling this option disconnects the supply. Does not power interior appliances or prevent installation/removal.
Sandbox_VehicleLivingSlots_EnableRoofPet: Enable vehicle petrol can quick menu
Allows collecting petrol from installed roof cans into carried containers using the original fuel-pump menu. Does not refuel the vehicle fuel tank or prevent can installation/removal.
Sandbox_VehicleLivingSlots_EnableRoofPro: Enable vehicle propane tank quick menu
Allows refuelling a blowtorch from installed roof propane tanks beside the vehicle. Does not prevent tank installation/removal or change built-in KI5 camper propane tanks.
Sandbox_VehicleLivingSlots_EnableWaterTa: Enable vehicle water tank quick menu
Allows quick filling, drinking, collecting water and washing from the vehicle water tank while outside. Does not prevent tank installation/removal or change interior equipment functions.
